name: WARNING: Raw Brussels Sprouts & Shredded Brussels Slaw
whyItWorks: Dense, compact raw Brussels sprouts shredded into salads and slaws. Extremely high in insoluble woody cellulose and raffinose trisaccharide, causing violent intestinal gas, colonic spasms, and obstruction hazard.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid all raw shredded Brussels sprouts salads and slaws. Substitute with well-cooked peeled root vegetables or steamed peeled squash.
